sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Cosmic Hunt is its unique word-finding mechanic. Instead of searching for words horizontally or vertically, you'll drag your mouse or tap the screen to find words hidden in every direction. This adds a new level of complexity and challenge to the game, making it feel fresh and exciting even for experienced puzzle players.

The game features a grid-based system, where letters are arranged in a 6x6 grid. Your task is to find words hidden within this grid, using letters that are adjacent to each other. You can move your cursor or tap the screen to highlight a word, and the game will let you know if it's a valid word or not.

One of the key features of Cosmic Hunt is its use of word chaining. This means that you can find words that are connected to each other, either horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. This adds a new level of strategy to the game, as you'll need to think carefully about where to find each word and how to connect them.

The game also features a timer, which adds an extra level of challenge to the game. In Hard Mode, you'll need to find words as quickly as possible, while in Normal Mode, you'll have more time to think and plan your strategy. This makes the game feel more dynamic and engaging, as you'll need to adapt your approach to the time available.
